exposure: Preterm birth (PTB) at different postconceptional ages (PCA 28, 29, 30 days)
outcome: Neurobehavioral deficit (exploration, anxiety, spontaneous alteration, discriminatory index)
cohort: Newborn rabbits delivered prematurely (PCA 28, 29, 30 days) or at term (PCA 31 days) via caesarean section.
finding: Earlier preterm birth (PCA 28d and 29d) in a rabbit model is associated with more severe and persistent neurobehavioral deficits, whereas later preterm birth (PCA 30d) shows milder and more transient issues.
